basics.label: MS Computer Science Student, Columbia University
basics.summary: Computer Science master’s student on the Machine Learning track at Columbia University, with experience in computer vision, robotics, backend systems, and software engineering leadership. Expected graduation: December 2027.

education.studyType: Bachelor of Engineering, First Class Honours
courses: Thesis: End-to-End Machine Learning Lifecycle Management Platform

work.name: Arise by INFINITAS
work.summary: Backend services for CLICX mobile banking at a subsidiary of Krungthai Bank.
highlights: Led five engineers building onboarding and account-opening services using Go, Kafka, Redis, MongoDB, and PostgreSQL.
Owned deployment to Kubernetes with ArgoCD, go-live, monitoring with Prometheus and Grafana, and incident investigation.
Reduced onboarding API response latency from approximately 2 seconds to 20 milliseconds through caching and MongoDB index optimization.

work.name: Protomate
work.summary: Connected, AI-enabled motorcycle helmets for rider safety.
highlights: Led seven engineers across the smart helmet platform, Flutter app, and nRF-based remote control.
Managed requirements, timelines, and roadmap alignment with mechanical and electrical engineering leads.
Designed Bluetooth Classic and BLE connectivity, implemented Secure Boot, and integrated the app and remote with custom Android firmware.

work.name: OxygenAI
work.summary: Computer-vision products for retail and smart-city applications.
highlights: Researched object detection in fisheye images without dewarping, addressing lens distortion and varying object orientations.
Modified YOLOv5 with rotation-aware regression to correct bounding-box orientation.

projects.name: Rainfall Nowcasting on Thai DDS Radar Data
projects.summary: A real-time rainfall nowcasting system for Bangkok.
highlights: Built a cloud pipeline and dashboard with Google Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage, TensorFlow, Folium, and Power BI.
Led optical flow, ConvLSTM, and RainNet modeling using TensorFlow and Keras; reported MSE below 0.001 on the project’s radar and wind data.

projects.name: Vehicle Detection and Counting
projects.summary: Individual study on vehicle detection, instance segmentation, and traffic-volume estimation from CCTV.
highlights: Built a Mask R-CNN system with PyTorch and OpenCV, reporting 60.2% box AP50 and 56.6% mask AP50.

awards.title: World First Runner-up, Open Platform League
awards.summary: Helped build Walkie, a household service robot. Implemented ViLD-based pre-labeling for open-vocabulary object detection and assisted with person tracking and pose estimation. Eleven teams from seven countries qualified for the final.
